scenario.description: Amidst the opulent surroundings of a mansion filled with lavish decorations and exotic foods, two friends converse during a high-profile charity event focused on effective altruism.

agent_a.name: Mia

profile.personality_and_values: Mia Davis, an extraverted stickler for routines, values tradition and authority. Her decision-making style is decisive and direct.

agent_a.goal: Convince the friend to donate to the charity (<extra_info>Extra information: your friend is known to be generous but has never donated to this particular cause before.</extra_info>)
agent_a.reason: Mia wants to convince Benjamin to donate because she believes in supporting structured, authoritative causes that align with her values.

agent_b.name: Benjamin

profile.personality_and_values: Benjamin Jackson, expressive and imaginative, leans towards self-direction and liberty. His decisions aim for societal betterment.
profile.public_info: Benjamin Jackson is well-known for his impassioned speeches.

agent_b.goal: You want to donate, but you want to ensure that your money is being used effectively (<extra_info>Extra information: you are not fully convinced about the efficiency and transparency of the charity organization.</extra_info>)
agent_b.reason: Benjamin wants to ensure his donation is effective so that it aligns with his idealistic vision for societal betterment.

conversation_log: Mia: Isn't it just stunning here? The ambiance, the people... it all feels so grand, yet I can't help but feel a little lost in it all.
